foundations.config:
name = "countingFoundations"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["CountingFoundations"]

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git"
rev = "d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "CountingFoundations"
roots = []
globs = [
  "Counting.Foundation.+",
  "Counting.Encoding.+",
  "Counting.Computation.+",
  "Counting.Complexity.+",
  "Counting.Bridge.HolantWitness",
  "Counting.Examples.Machines",
  "Counting.Examples.WitnessVerifier",
  "Counting.Foundations",
  "CountingClients"
]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Holant"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "PlanarHom"

partition-semantics.config:
name = "partitionSemantics"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["CountingPartitionSemantics"]
weakLeanArgs = ["-M6000", "-j1"]

[leanOptions]
autoImplicit = false

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git"
rev = "d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "CountingPartitionSemantics"
roots = []
globs = [
  "Counting.Model.+",
  "Counting.Gadget.+",
  "Counting.Upstream.+",
  "Counting.Bridge.ComplexCSP",
  "Counting.Bridge.PlanarHom",
  "Counting.Bridge.Holant",
  "Counting.Examples.EdgeCases",
  "Counting.Examples.GraphEdgeCases",
  "Counting.Examples.Substitution",
  "Counting.PartitionSemantics",
  "Counting.Bridges",
  "Counting.Examples",
  "Counting.All"
]

holant-unified.config:
name = "holantUnified"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["CountingHolantUnified"]
weakLeanArgs = ["-M12000", "-j1"]

[leanOptions]
autoImplicit = false

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
git = "https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4.git"
rev = "d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Holant"
globs = ["Holant", "Holant.+"]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Paper2"
globs = ["Paper2", "Paper2.+"]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "CountingHolantUnified"
roots = []
globs = ["Counting.HolantUnified", "Counting.HolantUnified.+"]

[[lean_lib]]
name = "Verification"
roots = []
globs = ["Verification.+"]
